operators.name: custom_stack_relu

returns.shape: output tensor shape after stacking num_repeats copies along dim and applying relu

semantics: Corresponds to torch.stack([x] * num_repeats, dim=dim) followed by torch.relu.
Input x is a CUDA tensor of float32.
The output tensor has the same number of dimensions plus one; the new dimension of size num_repeats is inserted at position dim.
The values are copied from x, preserving original order.
relu is applied elementwise: y = max(x, 0).
The return type is a tensor of float32 on CUDA with the specified shape.
Stack copies of input x along dimension self.input_size (which is 1 in this task).
No value modification, only dimension insertion and replication.
Apply ReLU elementwise to the stacked tensor.
Values are clamped to be non-negative.
Return the final ReLU output tensor.
